name: WEB Travel Group limited Unsponsored ADR
summary: Specializing in digital travel solutions, WEB Travel Group Ltd. functions as an online travel agency, empowering users to effortlessly discover and book various services. Through its platform, customers worldwide can arrange domestic and international flights, acquire travel insurance, secure vehicle rentals, and reserve hotel accommodations. The company, which has its main operations in Melbourne, Australia, was co-founded by David Clarke, Allan Nahum, and John Lemish in 1998.
